jobs.description:
We are looking for a Data Domain Specialist with prior industry experience who can help interpret and review client-provided mechanical and manufacturing-related data. This role acts as a bridge between client data and internal teams, ensuring the data being processed is relevant, accurate, and useful.

Key Responsibilities

 - Understand and review mechanical and manufacturing-related client data

 - Guide data processing teams on data relevance and usage

 - Help define tagging and classification guidelines

 - Review processed outputs and provide feedback for corrections

 - Support quality checks and validation activities

 - Assist during client discussions when domain input is required

 - Strong understanding of mechanical and manufacturing concepts

 - Ability to interpret technical data and explain it clearly to non-domain teams

 - Experience with reviewing, validating, or tagging data
   

Nice to Have

 - Experience working with Engineering design docs, BOM, PLM Software and CAD models

 - Experience working with data, analytics, or AI teams

 - Exposure to quality, process, or documentation-heavy projects

 - Familiarity with tools used for tagging or reviewing data
   

What We’re Looking For

 - Strong domain fundamentals with a practical mindset

 - Ability to make judgment calls on data relevance

 - Good communication and collaboration skills

Comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment

jobs.role: Radiologist - Chest CT Annotation - AI Project (India)
jobs.description:
We are seeking radiologists with a chest/thoracic background to carry out structural annotation on de-identified chest CT scans, with a focus on spatial accuracy and consistency against detailed annotation guidelines.

You will work asynchronously on a dedicated annotation platform, marking points, boxes and measurements on findings that have already been flagged upstream, to support the development of clinical AI imaging models.

This is a remote, flexible and short-term project.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:


 - Click-point placement: Mark specific coordinates on a scan, such as the centre of a nodule.

 - Bounding boxes: Draw boxes around defined regions of interest, such as a flagged lesion.

 - Simple measurements: Record diameter, or distance between two marked points, on segmentations or polygons already drawn.

 - Guideline application: Work to an annotation guideline covering placement conventions, boundary definitions and measurement rules, applied consistently across a large volume of studies.

 - Edge case handling: Flag ambiguous cases with a short rationale so guidance can be refined.



This is structural markup project with no interpretation required. You will not be reading scans for diagnosis, judging malignancy, or making clinical decisions. 



QUALIFICATIONS:


 - Registration: Registered radiologist in your country of practice with active license

 - Experience: 3–10 years' experience in radiology, with a chest/thoracic focus 

 - Knowledge: Strong grounding in thoracic anatomy and cross-sectional CT.

 - Attention to detail: Proven accuracy and consistency in image review or measurement work.

 - Technical proficiency: Comfortable using structured annotation tools and digital platforms.

 - Prior imaging annotation experience is an advantage but not required.

 - Language: Native or near-native written English.



LEGAL STATUS:


 - You will have the right to work in your country of residence.

 - You will work as an independent contractor.



WHY JOIN US?


 - Flexible Work Arrangements: Part-time, remote and fully asynchronous.

 - Competitive Compensation: Hourly rate, paid weekly.

 - Professional Development: Hands-on experience in clinical AI development and medical imaging, shaping how AI systems localise and measure findings on CT.

INVESTMENT BANKING AI RESEARCHER

(Pitch Books, Deal Decks)

Full time | Remote — India


ABOUT US

Aptura is a London-based company working on understanding how AI is changing professional work. We look closely at how finance and advisory professionals actually work, and where AI helps or falls short. The company was founded by people with backgrounds at Lazard, McKinsey and Partners Group.


ROLE DESCRIPTION

We are looking for Subject Matter Experts from investment banking who have spent years building pitch books, teasers and deal decks. You know what a client-ready slide looks like, and how far most AI output still is from it.

You have used AI tools on your own work and been frustrated by the mistakes they make, or you simply want to find out how good they really are.

You will turn that experience into realistic PowerPoint tasks that test how well AI do the deck work of a junior banker.


RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE

 - Writing realistic PowerPoint tasks drawn from your own deal work: building decks from source documents, filling corporate templates, rolling decks forward and making precise edits

 - Working through each task yourself so there is a clear, correct answer

 - Writing a yes-or-no checklist precise enough that an AI grader can mark any attempt against it


NECESSARY SKILLS INCLUDE

 - 2+ years in M&A, ECM, DCM or leveraged finance at a bank or advisory boutique

 - Deep hands-on PowerPoint: native charts, tables and corporate templates

 - Ability to define what a correct deck looks like precisely enough for someone else to grade against it

 - Clear writing. Tasks must be written by you, not by AI tools

 - Attention to detail, and willingness to learn concepts in AI and data


HOW IT WORKS

 1. Apply with your details and CV. After applying, verify your email and choose an available 30-minute group walkthrough call. You can book immediately; there is no application-approval step before booking.

 2. Attend the walkthrough and enter the code shared by the host at the end of the call to unlock your task workspace.

 3. Create one original task from your own work in about 45 minutes. Submit the brief, the actual input files needed to complete it, a written expected result and at least five binary rubric checks, each with one skill tag. Input-file uploads are compulsory.

 4. Write the brief and rubric yourself, without AI drafting, rewriting or polishing. Input materials must also be human-authored. Use only materials you are authorised to share, with confidential employer or client information removed.

 5. Submit through your account for automated screening and team review. Follow any request for revisions in your account. Completing onboarding does not guarantee a job offer; selection remains subject to review.

jobs.role: Member of Technical Staff - Microarchitectural Validation
jobs.description:
About Architect Labs

Architect is a frontier AI lab for custom silicon. We partner with frontier labs, clouds / neoclouds, physical AI companies, and advanced fabs to tape-out custom chips co-designed for next-generation AI workloads. Our goal is to compress end-to-end software to silicon timelines, and maximize intelligence per watt and per dollar for the world. We are a small exceptional team across silicon, systems, software and frontier AI. Our team have led research teams at nearly every frontier AI lab, and at some of the most complex SoCs in the world.

What You'll Do

As a Member of the Technical Staff on the Design Verification & Validation team at Architect, you'll own the verification strategy behind AI-generated designs taping out on leading foundries. You'll work at the intersection of rigorous hardware verification and AI-driven design automation.

 - Review AI-driven test plan, and validation strategy for internal and external SoC projects.

 - Provide domain-specific expertise to our AI/ML teams, including architectural and microarchitectural checks, validation modularity, checkers, coverage models, and interface protocols — helping encode DV best practices into our AI-driven flows.

 - Independently define, drive, and coordinate validation, verification, and integration flows across multiple IPs, including checkpoints and collateral handoffs.

 - Collaborate with architecture, design, and AI/ML leads to generate simulation- and emulation-ready collateral that scales across projects.

 - Track emerging trends in semiconductor verification and AI-driven design automation to keep our methodology cutting-edge in quality, scalability, and throughput.

What We'd Like to See

Qualifications & Skills:

 - Degree: Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field.

 - Tapeout Experience: 5+ years (10+ preferred) working on advanced-node tapeouts at top chip companies or fast-moving silicon startups. End-to-end silicon delivery is a strong plus.

 - Verification Expertise: Deep expertise in verification/validation, emulation, and architectural and system-level verification of industry-standard IPs. Proven track record defining microarchitectural checkers and monitors, modeling IP and SoC validation platforms, and developing modular, reusable validation collateral.

 - Coding: Strong skills in SystemVerilog, UVM, and C/C++ for test environments. Python strongly preferred.

 - Subsystem Depth: Hands-on verification experience in at least one of the following areas:
   
   - ARM/AMBA protocols (APB, AHB, AXI, and ideally ACE for coherent CPU interfaces)
   
   - CPU subsystems — boot, interrupts, debug, coherency
   
   - Memory controllers and PHY — LPDDR/DDR interfaces, controller-level verification
   
   - On-chip interconnect / NoC — routing, arbitration, QoS, bandwidth
   
   - NPU / ML accelerator cores — datapath, scratchpad memory, DMA engines
   
   - Security IPs and/or working with secure enclaves

 - Methodology: Hands-on experience with simulation and emulation flows and methodologies. Experience mapping IP and SoC designs to FPGA prototypes for fast functional verification.

 - Execution: Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills with strong attention to detail. Ability to work independently and drive cross-functional alignment.

 - Leadership: Ability and desire to lead the DV function over time as the team scales.

Expected Exposure (beyond the baseline above):

Candidates should also bring hands-on exposure to most of the following:

 - Microarchitecture: Working knowledge of the architecture and microarchitecture of complex digital subsystems, such as CPUs, XPUs, cache-coherency fabrics (NoCs/switches), memory hierarchies, and high-speed I/O (HSIO) protocols.

 - Advanced Pre-Silicon Verification: Experience contributing to coverage-driven verification using advanced UVM environments, formal verification, and emulation to validate microarchitectural boundary conditions and corner cases.

 - Post-Silicon Debug: Participation in post-silicon triage and debug, mapping observed silicon behavior back to RTL using logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and internal debug hooks.

 - End-to-End Debug: A track record of isolating and resolving hard HW/FW/SW interaction bugs, performance bottlenecks, or protocol violations, in pre-silicon environments and/or post-silicon bring-up.

Bonus:

 - SoC-level DV experience — bringing up full systems with memory controller + PHY + CPU connectivity, validating top-level integration.

 - Deep experience with AMBA protocols, specifically ACE for coherent CPU-memory access.

 - FPGA prototyping experience (ideally Xilinx Vivado/Vitis).

 - Verification experience spanning multiple of: interconnects, CPU subsystems, ARM AMBA, memory controllers, NPUs.

 - Tapeout experience at frontier AI chip startups (MatX, Groq, Cerebras, d-Matrix, etc.) or tier-1 silicon companies (Apple, NVIDIA, Google, Qualcomm, Broadcom, AMD).

What We Offer

 - Competitive salary and meaningful equity stake

 - Fast-paced startup with autonomy and visible impact

 - Cutting-edge challenges at the intersection of AI and silicon design

ABOUT AVOCA

Avoca is transforming how home service companies engage with their customers. Our AI-powered conversational agents handle every high-value inbound call, from booking jobs, qualifying leads, and driving higher revenue, all at a speed and consistency unmatched by human call centers.

We're a Series B startup backed by Kleiner Perkins, Meritech Capital, General Catalyst, and other top-tier investors, with $125M raised and a $1B valuation. We grew 10x in 2025 and have scaled to 170+ employees in under two years across our NYC headquarters and Santa Barbara office.

In a $1T+ market where 85% of missed calls go to competitors, we're building the category-defining platform for AI-driven customer engagement, serving the largest brands in home services. With high-energy, in-office teams in both locations, every hire here has an immediate and visible impact.



Must be available to work during Eastern Time Zone (EDT/EST) business hours




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a highly technical Deployment Engineer to join our remote team. As a DE, you'll embed directly with customers — understanding their operations, designing tailored AI solutions, and deploying systems that deliver immediate impact from day one. You'll take ownership of deployments, integrations, and operational support of Avoca's voice agent products in live customer environments, operating with high autonomy in ambiguous, high-stakes situations.

This role requires deep technical expertise, strong root-cause diagnosis skills, and exceptional communication to keep our solutions running reliably in production.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Embed with customers to understand their operations and deliver working AI solutions from day one

 - Deploy, integrate, and maintain Avoca's voice agent products within complex customer infrastructure

 - Build and maintain the infrastructure behind conversational AI — APIs, integrations, monitoring, and feedback loops

 - Diagnose production issues and perform deep root-cause analysis across distributed systems, APIs, and LLM-powered workflows

 - Translate business requirements into technical architectures and deployment plans

 - Identify patterns across deployments and feed insights back into the product roadmap

 - Monitor and optimize product performance in production, working directly with LLMs and distributed systems

 - Communicate complex technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

 - Document solutions, best practices, and troubleshooting processes to raise the whole team's operational bar




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 2+ years of software engineering experience, preferably backend or systems-focused

 - Proficiency in Python (TypeScript/JavaScript a plus)

 - Hands-on experience with microservices architectures, APIs, SQL/NoSQL databases, networking, and distributed systems

 - Familiarity with major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

 - Experience diagnosing and debugging production systems and integration environments

 - Strong communicator, able to work with both technical and non-technical, customer-facing stakeholders

 - Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, vector databases, or AI agent frameworks

 - Customer-facing technical experience is a plus

 - Ability to work remotely while collaborating with a high-performing team across US time zones

 




WHY AVOCA

At Avoca, you’ll be part of a team that’s building a category-defining company at the center of a massive market opportunity. We’re a fast-moving, collaborative team with a culture designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and impact.

The Bengaluru team is product engineering, so everything you build is customer-facing.

What You'll Do

 - Development & Implementation - Build scalable backend services, APIs, and AI-powered features using TypeScript/Node.js, Python, and cloud platforms.

 - Collaboration & Learning - Work closely with senior engineers, participate in code reviews, and contribute to technical and architecture discussions.

 - Product Integration - Partner with Product, Design, and Customer Success to translate requirements into robust, customer-facing solutions.

Specifically, you'll:

 - Build and ship features end-to-end, from backend services to customer-facing interfaces.

 - Work on AI-powered workflows: prompt design, evaluation, and the systems that make LLMs reliable in production.

 - Build integrations with CRM systems, scheduling platforms, and third-party communication tools.

 - Fix real customer problems, often with a short loop between report and fix going live.

 - Write comprehensive tests, add monitoring, and take ownership of what you ship after it ships.

 - Participate in on-call rotation and incident response to ensure system reliability.

 - Take loosely defined problems, ask the right questions, and drive them to done with minimal hand-holding.

Work Environment & Schedule

 - Hybrid, based in Bengaluru - regular office presence expected for collaboration and team coordination.

 - Some overlap with US business hours may be needed for client coordination and project work.

What You'll Bring

 - 2+ years of software engineering experience, ideally full-stack, including at least 1 year in a fast-paced startup or growth-stage environment.

 - Strong programming skills in modern JavaScript/TypeScript and Python, with backend development experience.

 - Hands-on experience with AWS or GCP and modern deployment practices.

 - Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs and understanding of service-oriented architectures.

 - Comfort working with SQL databases at scale.

 - A track record of fast, high-quality execution - you move quickly and your work holds up.

 - Self-driven: you unblock yourself, chase down context, and don't need work broken into small pieces.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and changing requirements in a fast-moving startup.

 - Curiosity about AI and LLMs - direct experience is a plus, appetite to learn is required.

 - Low ego, high energy, and a bias toward shipping.

Bonus Points

 - Experience with AI/ML technologies, LLMs, or conversational AI systems.

 - Background in B2B SaaS or enterprise software.

 - Previous startup experience or exposure to rapid scaling.

 - Contributions to open source or active developer community participation.

 - Experience with real-time systems, or event-driven architectures.

 - Familiarity with Docker/containerization and orchestration tools.

Why Avoca

 - Compensation in line with industry standards and above.

 - Direct impact - your code powers thousands of businesses and millions of customer interactions.

 - Accelerated learning - work on cutting-edge AI technology with experienced mentors.

 - Clear paths for advancement as the company and team scale.

Blitzy is a Cambridge, MA based AI software development platform on a mission to revolutionize the software development life cycle by autonomously building custom software to unlock the next industrial revolution. We're transforming how enterprises build software, turning enterprise requirements into enterprise grade code with an agentic software development platform that can autonomously execute 80% of the quantum of software development work. We're backed by multiple tier 1 investors, and have proven success as founders of previous start-ups.




OUR CULTURE

Who we are:

Led by two pioneering co-founders we are one of the fastest growing companies in the U.S., creating our own category of enterprise autonomous software development. We automate thousands of hours of software development for our customers, which includes strong representation within the Fortune 500.

How we work:

 - We move Blitzy Fast: Time is both our company’s and our clients’ most precious asset. We move quickly and decisively to innovate internally and deliver exceptional software externally.

 - Championship Mindset: We operate like a professional sports team. We win as a team by holding ourselves and each other to high standards, collaborating in-person, and remaining focused on the mission.

 - Passion for Invention: We’re pushing the frontier of what’s possible, requiring constant innovation and iteration.

 - We Work for the Customer: We focus on delivering outsized value to the customers we work with and expanding those relationships into deep, meaningful partnerships.
   
   


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to join our Pune HQ2 team and work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and complex enterprise software. You’ll embed with customer engineering teams and help them transform how they build software with Blitzy. This isn’t a hand-coding or traditional solutions engineering role. You’ll onboard new teams, guide them through the platform, troubleshoot issues, and work with client engineers on architecture and priorities, with the goal of getting each team to run Blitzy independently.


Our HQ2 FDE team deploys alongside customers around the world, working closely with US-based engineering and customer teams with regular time zone overlap for collaboration and handoffs. You’ll partner with customer stakeholders across regions and help each engagement run smoothly from kickoff to steady state.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Deploy Blitzy into complex enterprise environments, navigating technical constraints and translating customer business goals into practical technical solutions

 - Embed with customer teams during critical implementations, partnering with engineering leaders on sprint planning, architecture reviews, technical decisions, and production deployments

 - Build production-quality integrations, services, and extensions using Java 17 and Spring Boot 3.x, including Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, and Actuator

 - Build and evolve REST APIs using a contract-first approach with OpenAPI/Swagger, with data persistence through PostgreSQL, Hibernate/JPA, and Liquibase

 - Package and deploy containerized services with Docker and manage dependencies through Maven, including BOMs and multi-module projects

 - Develop custom solutions, reusable patterns, scripts, and tools that accelerate customer adoption and demonstrate Blitzy’s capabilities in enterprise environments

 - Debug complex issues spanning customer infrastructure, integrations, microservices, and the Blitzy platform, supporting production operations, health checks, metrics, and configuration management

 - Drive successful POCs and technical demonstrations that showcase advanced use cases, deliver measurable value, and expand into enterprise-wide deployments

 - Maintain high standards for testing, code quality, performance, and observability using JUnit 5, Cucumber/Gherkin, JMeter, Git, Logback/SLF4J, SpotBugs, and SonarQube

 - Identify recurring customer needs, technical patterns, and expansion opportunities that inform product priorities and enterprise adoption

 - Collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate field experience into platform improvements, technical documentation, reusable best practices, and contributions to the core product

 


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 10+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of shipping production code in enterprise environments

 - Deep hands-on expertise with Java 17, Spring Boot 3.x, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, Hibernate/JPA, and Actuator

 - Strong experience with REST APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger, PostgreSQL, Liquibase, Maven, Docker, and modern testing practices including JUnit 5, Cucumber/Gherkin, and JMeter

 - Experience building and operating microservices with CI/CD, cloud architecture, observability, production monitoring, and tools such as Micrometer, Dynatrace, SpotBugs, and SonarQube

 - Knowledge of enterprise modernization and distributed systems, including Java 8 → Java 17 upgrades, monolith → microservices migrations, Kafka, Avro, Schema Registry, caching, and resilience patterns

 - Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum and modern software development practices, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to audiences ranging from interns to CTOs

 - Experience in customer-facing engineering, developer tools, AI/ML, or enterprise modernization is a plus, along with technical thought leadership through blogs, talks, or open-source contributions

 - Passion for AI-powered software development and willingness to work in person from Pune, India, with overlap for US-based teams

At Broccoli, we're building AI teammates for the people who build and maintain our world.

We're still just getting started.

 


SOFTWARE ENGINEER @ BROCCOLI

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to help build the AI intelligence layer that runs front-office operations for home service businesses. You’ll work on systems that don’t just generate responses—but take real actions like booking jobs, dispatching technicians, and driving revenue.

This is a product engineering role. You won’t just write code—you’ll shape how the product works in the real world, talking to customers, understanding edge cases, and shipping quickly.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build end-to-end features across backend and frontend that directly impact customer revenue

 - Improve system reliability, performance, and developer velocity as we scale

 - Learn fast by working directly with customers and iterating based on real usage

 - 2-4 years of experience building and shipping products

 - Strong fundamentals across backend and frontend systems

 - High ownership—you don’t wait for specs, you figure things out

 - Curiosity for how real businesses operate, not just how software works

 - Ability to move fast without breaking things that matter

Technology & Automation-

THE ROLE

The Customer Engagement Manager owns a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts end-to-end: every engagement, every outcome, every relationship, every expansion opportunity. Think of this as the McKinsey Associate Partner model applied to enterprise AI delivery.

You are the single point of accountability for your accounts. The customer calls you — not your manager — when they have a problem. You staff delivery teams, oversee solution quality, run executive readouts, measure ROI, drive adoption, rebuild trust when things break, and grow the book through proven production value.

This is not a project management role. This is an account ownership role that combines delivery orchestration, outcome ownership, customer leadership, and commercial growth.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN

1. Account Ownership

 - Own your accounts end-to-end: every engagement, every outcome, every relationship. Everything good or bad stops with you.

 - Be the single point of contact the customer calls for any problem — delivery, quality, adoption, escalation, or expansion.

 - Maintain a holistic view of each account: engagement status, risk exposure, opportunity pipeline, and the customer’s strategic priorities for the quarter.

 - Run account planning: engagement roadmaps, resource forecasting, risk assessment, and growth strategy.

2. Delivery Orchestration

 - Staff and direct delivery teams (Engineering Leads, Product Managers) across your accounts.

 - Oversee delivery quality across all engagements: review solution architectures, attend go-live rehearsals, ensure evaluation rigor.

 - Manage cross-engagement dependencies within an account (e.g., shared integration infrastructure between parallel deployments).

 - Serve as the delivery escalation point: join war rooms, coordinate fixes across Engineering and Product, and communicate resolution to the customer.

 - You don’t write code — but you review architectures, challenge unrealistic scope, and ensure go-live readiness. Your leverage is orchestration and judgment.

3. Outcome Ownership & Continuous Improvement

 - Own post-go-live outcomes: adoption, ROI, accuracy, and user trust. This role absorbs the Outcomes Manager function for your accounts.

 - Run regular usage readouts: AI deflection rates, false positive/negative trends, HITL escalation patterns, user bypass rates, and trust signals.

 - Separate product gaps from process, training, or expectation gaps. Not everything that looks broken is an engineering problem.

 - Drive continuous improvement cycles: readout → diagnose → prioritize → fix → re-measure.

 - Communicate outcomes in business language: efficiency gains, cost savings, error reduction — not just dashboards, but diagnosis and action plans.

4. Executive Stakeholder Leadership

 - Run QBRs with VP/C-level stakeholders: present outcomes, risks, improvement plans, and the strategic roadmap.

 - Navigate internal customer politics: when the VP of IT and VP of Business disagree on priorities, facilitate alignment around shared success metrics.

 - Communicate bad news credibly: present the data, the diagnosis, and the recovery plan — without losing trust.

 - Handle C-level escalations. When the CTO threatens to terminate or the CFO questions ROI, you are the person in the room.

5. Commercial Growth

 - Grow your book through outcome-driven expansion: deliver the first SOW excellently, measure ROI rigorously, present evidence to the C-suite, then propose the next SOW grounded in proven value.

 - Identify new use cases by deeply understanding customer business processes and pain points — not by pushing a product catalog.

 - Know when to push for expansion vs. when to stabilize. Premature expansion erodes trust. You earn the right to grow by delivering first.

 - Co-sell with Sales: provide the delivery credibility and outcome evidence that makes expansion proposals close.

6. Product & Platform Partnership

 - Act as the voice of your customers to Product and Core Engineering. Translate field patterns into structured, actionable feedback — not one-off requests.

 - Identify cross-customer patterns that signal platform gaps or opportunities.

 - Partner with Product on customer-facing roadmap discussions: what’s coming, what’s not, and how to manage expectations.

7. Team Development

 - Coach Engineering Leads and Implementation Managers on architecture quality, customer communication, delivery discipline, and outcome thinking.

 - Promote shared standards and best practices across engagements.

 - Build reusable account-level assets: engagement playbooks, QBR templates, outcome tracking frameworks, and expansion qualification criteria.

Required

 - 15+ years in enterprise technology delivery, consulting, account management, or customer leadership.

 - 5+ years owning enterprise accounts end-to-end: delivery, outcomes, relationship, and growth — not individual projects within someone else’s account.

 - Track record managing or directing delivery teams (Engineering Leads, TPMs, consultants) assigned to their accounts.

 - Post-go-live outcome ownership: measured ROI, tracked adoption, driven continuous improvement, and rebuilt trust after production issues.

 - Commercial accountability: grown account revenue through outcome-driven expansion, not just retention.

 - Enterprise stakeholder management at VP/C-level across multiple concurrent accounts.

 - Production track record — beyond POCs. Scale and accountability required.

jobs.description:
ABOUT EMA

Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.

We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.

Ema builds AI agents that act on sensitive enterprise data and systems. You’ll make sure the agents, and the platform they run on, are secure by design. You’ll build security controls for autonomous agents operating across multi-tenant enterprise environments, including cloud, on-prem and air-gapped deployments. You’ll solve zero-trust problems where the code isn’t static logic but non-deterministic models making live API calls against sensitive customer data. Our agents orchestrate 100+ LLMs, call third-party tools through MCP, execute code in sandboxes and drive headless browsers, and each of those is an attack surface you’ll help define.




ROLE OVERVIEW




WHAT YOU’LL OWN




AI AND AGENT SECURITY

 - Threat model new AI agent features before launch: direct and indirect prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration through agent outputs, and over-privileged tool use

 - Design guardrails for agentic workflows: least-privilege tool and connector scopes, human-in-the-loop approvals for high-risk actions, and output filtering

 - Enforce tenant and data isolation across retrieval (RAG), context stores, and model calls, so no customer’s data leaks into another’s context

 - Secure the AI supply chain: model and provider vetting, third-party MCP servers and connectors, prompt and config versioning

 - Run AI red-team exercises and build automated adversarial tests (prompt injection suites) into CI




CLOUD AND PLATFORM SECURITY

 - Security baselines for Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure: RBAC, network policies, workload identity, secrets management, per-tenant network isolation

 - Security in CI/CD: IaC scanning, SAST and dependency scanning, policy-as-code guardrails




WHAT YOU’LL CONTRIBUTE TO

 - AI-aware detection with our current technology and tooling: logging prompts, tool calls and agent actions, and alerting on anomalous agent behavior

 - Partner with the Security & Compliance Lead on technical controls and evidence for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, HIPAA and ISO 42001, plus the NIST AI RMF




MUST-HAVES

 - 5+ years in cloud security, application security, or DevSecOps (GCP/Azure Preferred)

 - Deep hands-on Kubernetes and cloud security experience

 - Security automation with IaC (Terraform/Helm) and Python or Bash.

 - A working understanding of LLM application risks (OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications) and how agentic systems fail

 - Comfortable influencing engineers without formal authority




NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Hands-on experience securing LLM, RAG, or agentic systems in production

 - AI red teaming, or familiarity with MITRE ATLAS

 - CNAPP/CSPM tooling, SIEM/detection engineering

 - Contributions to AI security research, open-source tools, or CTFs




WHY JOIN EMA?



 - At the frontier of AI: Secure agentic systems that are driving real enterprise transformation.

 - Security is the product: Enterprise CISOs evaluate our security before they buy. Here it’s a core feature, not a checkbox.

 - Security as a peer, not a gate: You’ll report to the Security & Compliance Lead and partner directly with Engineering and Product leadership. You’ll sit in design reviews from day one and have a real say in what ships.

 - Ownership: Help set the baseline for enterprise trust in AI agents and shape the security DNA of a category-defining company.

 - Elite talent: Work with engineers and researchers from top-tier tech companies who value deep execution




EMA'S CULTURE & VALUES



 - High Bar on Quality: We value excellence and expect world-class execution.

 - Ownership & Accountability: We take full responsibility for our work and outcomes.

 - Impact-Driven Approach: We set ambitious goals and measure success through real-world impact.

 - No Hierarchy, Just Execution: Everyone is an individual contributor focused on delivering results.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

Ema Unlimited is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or genetics.

ABOUT EXA

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s, and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders, and dropouts alike. 

We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

Forward Deployed Engineers are the implementation and technical specialists. Once a customer signs, you become their engineering partner: you get them to production fast, make Exa a load-bearing part of their stack, and grow the account from there. You sit at the intersection of product, engineering, and customer success, and you're measured on adoption, consumption, retention, and expansion. 

You'll embed directly with customers' engineering teams to solve real problems with Exa's API. When something breaks, you fix it. When a feature is missing, you build it. When usage dips, you know why before the customer tells you. You're also our specialist bench: when a presales deal needs deeper expertise than our Solutions Architects have, you get pulled in to win it. This is not a support role. You are an engineer who owns the customer outcome. You'll cover accounts across APJ from India.

 


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Onboard new customers and take them from signed contract to production integration, owning the technical plan, milestones, and time-to-value

 - Drive consumption and adoption by finding new use cases, teams, and workloads inside each account and helping customers build them

 - Make Exa sticky by architecting integrations that are deeply embedded in customers' products, agents, and pipelines

 - Anticipate churn and contraction risk by monitoring usage data, quality signals, and customer interactions, then acting on issues before they become escalations

 - Identify and drive expansion with Account Executives, from usage growth to new products and commit upgrades

 - Debug and resolve technical issues across the full stack, from API behavior and retrieval quality to the customer's application code

 - Partner with Support to make sure customer issues are triaged, escalated, and resolved quickly, acting as the technical point of contact on escalations and closing the loop with the customer

 - Serve as a technical specialist in presales when Solutions Architects need deeper expertise on complex evaluations, custom architectures, or strategic accounts

 - Turn customer feedback into product improvements, spotting patterns across accounts and shipping fixes yourself when possible

 - Run technical reviews with customer CTOs, engineering leads, and PMs to align on roadmap, performance, and what's next


REQUIREMENTS

 - Several years of programming experience. You could build and deploy a production server from scratch

 - Experience working inside real codebases and production systems, ideally with search, retrieval, LLMs, or data pipelines

 - Track record of high performance in demanding environments, whether that's a top CS program, a competitive sport, a startup, or something else entirely

 - Comfort owning customer relationships over the long term and holding your own in high-stakes technical conversations

 - An analytical mindset: you can read usage data, spot trends, and turn them into a plan

 - High tolerance for context-switching, ambiguity, and sustained intensity

 - Willingness to travel as needed for customer engagements


YOU MIGHT EXCEL IF YOU...

 - Have built and shipped user-facing products end to end

 - Have worked as a software engineer, forward deployed, solutions, or customer engineer, or in a technical account management role with real ownership

 - Have driven retention, expansion, or usage growth at a previous company

 - Thrive in early-stage environments where your job description changes monthly

 - Are energized by the idea of being the person customers think of when they think of Exa

 - Care deeply about the problem of organizing the world's knowledge and making it accessible to machines

This is a remote opportunity in India. 



Exa is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related conditions, criminal histories consistent with applicable law, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

About the role

We’re looking for an experienced Robotics Software Engineer to join our team. As an early member, you will play a pivotal role in architecting scalable software for our robots. You will work on building robust and efficient frameworks to support real-time robotics applications. You'll need to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment where you'll wear multiple hats and have a direct impact on our product's evolution. We’re hiring a Workplace Experience Manager to run our Bangalore office. You’ll own how the office works every day: the food, the vendors behind it, the space, and what it feels like to walk in on your first day.

A lot of this doesn’t exist yet, so you’ll build it. You’ll find and negotiate with vendors, test new ideas through small pilots, listen to what the team tells you, and keep improving. You’ll also be one of the first people every new hire and visitor meets, which makes you their first impression of Handshake in Bangalore. We want someone who treats setting the culture as a core part of the job.

This is a contract, in-office role that requires five days a week onsite.




WHAT YOU’LL DO




VENDOR MANAGEMENT

 - Source and onboard vendors for meals, snacks, beverages, merch, transport, office supplies, etc

 - Compare at least three quotes, check licensing and references, and run tastings before we sign anyone

 - Negotiate pricing, minimum orders, payment terms, and service levels, and get them in writing

 - Be the single point of contact for every vendor: resolve missed deliveries and quality issues quickly, and keep backup options ready for critical services

 - Review each vendor monthly on quality, reliability, and cost, and renegotiate or replace the ones that slip

 - Own the snack, meal, and supply budget: track spend weekly, flag overruns early, and bring a recommendation for fixing them


FOOD PROGRAM

 - Plan weekly lunch and dinner menus that work for the whole team, including specific dietary needs (we just have vegetarian, non vegetarian, lactose intolerant now but this list might grow)

 - Confirm headcounts, coordinate orders, and make sure food arrives on time and is set up well

 - Keep the pantry stocked and rotate snacks based on what gets eaten and what gets left behind


PILOTS AND FEEDBACK

 - Test new ideas as short pilots before committing budget, whether that’s a new caterer, a snack subscription, or a weekly team ritual

 - Define success before each pilot starts (participation, cost per person, satisfaction score), run it for two to four weeks, then decide whether to scale it, change it, or stop it

 - Collect feedback continuously through pulse surveys, Slack polls, and conversations over lunch

 - Share a short monthly update on what you heard, what you changed, and what you’re testing next

 - Keep a simple log of every experiment and its results, so anyone can see what was tried and why it was kept or dropped


ONBOARDING AND CULTURE

 - Set the tone for every new hire and visitor: how you welcome people shapes how they see Handshake

 - Plan and run low-cost, high-impact monthly team bonding activities, plus small weekly rituals that bring people together

 - Build traditions for the Bangalore team, from festival celebrations to marking launches, milestones, and new joiners


OFFICE OPERATIONS

 - Optional but a big plus: book flights and accommodation for employees traveling between the India and US offices

DESIRED CAPABILITIES

 - Prior experience in office operations, workplace experience, administration, hospitality, or a similar role

 - Ownership: you notice what needs fixing and fix it without being asked

 - Comfortable working in a fast-paced, in-person environment and managing multiple priorities at once




EXTRA CREDIT

 - Event planning or team engagement experience, especially on a tight budget

 - Previous experience in a startup or fast-growing environment

 - Experience setting up an office or food program from scratch

 - Kannada or Hindi, for working with local vendors

ABOUT HANDSHAKE

Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.

In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to ~$1B run rate and pay ~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.

 


WHY JOIN HANDSHAKE NOW:

 - Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel

 - Partner hand-in-hand with world-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions

 - Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders

 - Build a massive, fast-growing business with billions in revenue


ABOUT HANDSHAKE AI

Human data is the core infrastructure to AI advancement. Frontier AI labs currently improve model capabilities with various data-intensive post-training techniques. We believe that data spend for AI training will increase by 3-5x in the next few years and continue for much longer as models take on new domains. Handshake AI supports all of the frontier AI labs, working on their most complex data at the largest scale.

We are building our India team to help accelerate the development of frontier models. This team is a critical, strategic investment for us - we have grown the team 3x in the past six months to help fuel our next phase of growth. India-based teammates will work hand-in-hand with US-based teams to scope, execute, and deliver critical human data projects to Frontier Labs and other customers.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Software Engineer II to help build our Reinforcement Learning Environments (RLE) platform—the interactive systems where frontier AI models learn to complete real-world work.

RLE environments simulate end-to-end workflows across domains like software engineering, finance, legal research, and business operations with realistic tools, constraints, and feedback loops. The interaction data generated powers the training and evaluation of the world's leading AI models.

As part of our growing engineering organization in India, you'll partner closely with Engineering, Research, Product, and Operations teams in the US to build the platforms powering the next generation of AI. You'll own meaningful technical projects, contribute to platform architecture, and help build reliable systems that enable researchers to rapidly develop and evaluate frontier AI models.

Location: Bengaluru, India. This is an in-office role.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design, build, and scale our Reinforcement Learning Environments (RLE) platform and the infrastructure that powers it

 - Partner closely with Engineering, Research, Product, and Operations teams in the US to execute against a shared roadmap

 - Design and implement scalable backend services and data generation pipelines

 - Build modular environment domains that integrate seamlessly with model training and evaluation workflows

 - Improve platform reliability, observability, performance, and developer productivity

 - Participate in technical design discussions and contribute to architecture decisions

 - Write high-quality, maintainable code while helping improve engineering standards and best practices


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 6+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend systems, distributed systems, or platform infrastructure

 - Strong proficiency with TypeScript, React, and modern backend architectures

 - Strong understanding of PostgreSQL, data modeling, distributed systems, and system design

 - Experience building and operating production systems on AWS or GCP

 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments

 - Experience collaborating effectively with globally distributed engineering teams, including teams based in the US


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with reinforcement learning infrastructure, simulation systems, or AI evaluation platforms

 - Experience building internal developer platforms or workflow orchestration systems

 - Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines

 - Experience supporting applied ML or AI research teams

 - Experience working in a fast-growing startup or high-growth engineering organization


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Reinforcement Learning Environments become a trusted platform powering the next generation of AI model training

 - New environments launch quickly with high-quality, scalable infrastructure

 - Systems are reliable, observable, and built to support rapid iteration

 - You become a trusted engineering partner across the India and US teams, helping deliver critical platform capabilities

You’ll Thrive Here If You:

 - Are motivated by solving operational problems that have direct, measurable impact.

 - Want to be part of a company shaping the future of AI through human data.

 - Can navigate ambiguity, act with urgency, and keep multiple workstreams moving in parallel.

Perks:

 - Generous Equity Grant vested over 4 years

 - Housing Bonus: 1.3 Lakhs spread throughout the first year

 - Well Defined Performance Bonus ranging between 10 - 100% of base

 - Medical Insurance Coverage

 - Food credit for every in person day.

 - Own critical growth initiatives from strategy through execution, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, and GTM.

 - Design and run scalable growth systems and data-driven experiments, optimizing the funnel from acquisition to activation.

 - Synthesize product, market, and operational data to surface opportunities and drive prioritization.

 - An entrepreneurial, bias-for-action mindset - comfortable with ambiguity and building from scratch.

 - Bachelor's degree required; engineering background strongly preferred, top-20 university or MBA a plus.
   
   


EXTRA CREDIT:

 - Experience launching or scaling AI/ML products (B2B or B2C).

 - A history of building scalable systems or pods from scratch in high-growth environments, with a high bar for execution quality.

This role is based in our Bangalore office and requires 3 days per week onsite. While the majority of the office will work Pacific Standard Time (PST), this role will work 11AM to 8PM IST with flexibility to 10 PM IST to better accommodate candidate schedules. 

 - Partner with hiring managers and senior stakeholders across business, operations, and technical teams to understand hiring needs, shape role scope, and align on priorities

 - Own the end-to-end recruiting process for a diverse set of roles, from intake and sourcing through interviews, offers, and close

 - Lead candidate scheduling, interview ops, and candidate logistics for evening and overnight interviews.

 - Build and maintain strong pipelines for hard-to-fill business, operations, and technical roles across India and other regions. Proactively engage passive talent and develop long-term candidate relationships

 - Provide insights on local and global talent markets, compensation expectations, and competitive dynamics to inform hiring decisions

 - Own interview scheduling, candidate logistics, and cross-time-zone coordination, ensuring a smooth, timely, and consistent candidate experience

 - Contribute to building recruiting processes, norms, and ways of working as the India office continues to grow

 - Deliver a thoughtful, high-quality candidate experience that reflects Handshake AI’s values and standards


YOU HAVE:

 - 7+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience supporting business, operations, and/or technical roles

 - Experience recruiting in a startup or fast-scaling environment, with comfort operating in ambiguity and evolving processes is a must

 - Strong experience partnering with hiring managers and senior stakeholders, with the ability to set expectations and communicate clearly

 - Experience recruiting for technical or specialized roles, with the ability to assess skill requirements and partner effectively with technical interviewers

 - Hands-on experience sourcing across multiple role types using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, CRM tools, and referrals

 - Comfortable supporting recruiting operations and coordination while maintaining ownership of individual requisitions

 - Ability to track recruiting metrics, identify trends, and adjust approach as needed

 - Clear written and verbal communication skills, especially across teams and time zones

About the Role

Handshake AI's Bangalore team is growing fast, and we need an HR Manager who can be the reliable first point of contact for our India-based employees - someone equally comfortable answering a benefits question, keeping us compliant with local labor law, and flexing up to help resolve a sensitive employee relations issue or support light workforce planning. This is a hands-on role with real range: mostly foundational HR work, done well, with room to stretch into higher-judgment partnering as you build.



 - Own front-line employee relations and HR compliance for our Bangalore team, resolving day-to-day policy, leave, and benefits questions accurately and on the same day

 - Independently triage and resolve routine employee complaints and workplace concerns, escalating complex cases to HRBP leadership with clear context and a recommended path

 - Maintain HR policies, documentation, and statutory compliance (POSH, PF, ESI, Shops & Establishments Act, gratuity, etc.) that keep Handshake AI audit-ready as the India team scales

 - Partner closely with recruiting on onboarding, offer logistics, and new-hire compliance, and collaborate cross-functionally with our US-based People team on shared processes and projects

 - Support light workforce and team planning - tracking headcount, leave, and org changes - so managers and HRBPs have accurate, up-to-date data to plan against

 - Manage the complete employee lifecycle, from onboarding through offboarding, ensuring smooth transitions, compliance, and a positive employee experience at every stage.






YOU HAVE:

 - 4-6 years of experience in an HR Manager, HR Generalist, or Associate HRBP role, ideally at a fast-growing tech or startup company

 - Working knowledge of Indian labor law and statutory compliance requirements (POSH, PF, ESI, Shops & Establishments Act, gratuity)

 - A track record of resolving employee questions and routine ER issues independently, with good judgment on what to escalate and when

 - Strong stakeholder management and partnership skills - comfortable building trust with employees, managers, recruiting, and a US-based People team

 - Comfort handling sensitive employee situations with discretion, empathy, and professionalism

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate policy into plain, practical language

 - Experience with HRIS, payroll/EOR, or ticketing tools (e.g., Deel, Workday, Freshservice) to manage employee inquiries at scale

 - High attention to detail and comfort operating with some ambiguity in a fast-moving environment

 - Genuine excitement about Handshake's mission and the AI economy.





Bonus points:

 - Experience working cross-functionally with a US-based team, including comfort with some overlap hours

 - Exposure to contractor, gig, or data-annotation workforce models

 - Familiarity partnering with Employers of Record (EOR) like Deel or Rippling

 - Prior experience flexing between generalist HR execution and higher-judgment HRBP-style partnering.






PERKS:

 - Generous Equity Grant vested over 4 years

 - Housing Bonus: 1.3 Lakhs spread throughout the first year

 - Well Defined Performance Bonus ranging between 10 - 100% of base

 - Medical Insurance Coverage

 - Food credit for every in person day.

ABOUT HANDSHAKE

Handshake's mission is to organize expert human knowledge to advance the AI economy. Handshake AI works directly with frontier labs on their most consequential data, evaluation, and post-training challenges, building the systems that turn expert human knowledge into the data and evaluations that make frontier models better.

You will work alongside engineers, researchers, operators, and builders from organizations including Scale AI, Meta, Google, Amazon, xAI, Notion, and Palantir—and help build the systems that make expert human knowledge useful for advancing AI.





ABOUT HANDSHAKE LABS

Handshake Labs is building external AI products, research platforms, and customer-facing AI systems. We are evolving work that is often custom-built for an individual partner into reusable products and platforms that improve with every deployment.

Our work spans the full post-training loop: designing evaluations and training environments, building high-quality data and feedback systems, running experiments, and turning what works into durable infrastructure. For example, we are developing agents that can analyze long, complex coding-agent sessions in days rather than weeks—with expert review and calibration built into the system.





THE ROLE

We are hiring a Member of Technical Staff to help build the data systems that make frontier model training possible. The data Handshake builds for and acquires on behalf of labs is getting more complex and more sensitive, and this role is responsible for improving how we generate, process, and prepare that data—whether that means building higher-quality synthetic and LLM-generated training data, or making acquired third-party data safe to use by removing personal information while preserving the structure that makes it valuable.

You will partner with researchers, domain experts, legal/compliance stakeholders, and customers to turn ambiguous data questions—about generation, quality, evaluation, or privacy—into experiments, pipelines, and durable products. Early members of the team will have unusual influence over our technical direction, standards, and culture.

Location:  Bangalore

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design and build systems that improve the quality, scale, and safety of the data Handshake generates and acquires for frontier model training—spanning synthetic data generation and data anonymization/PII removal.

 - Translate ambiguous research, partner, or compliance needs into clear hypotheses, experiments, evaluation plans, and production-quality implementations.

 - Build and improve data-processing pipelines, evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and quality-control systems, whether the goal is generating higher-signal synthetic data or verifying that sensitive data has been properly de-identified.

 - Run fast, rigorous iteration loops: prototype, evaluate, interpret results, and turn learnings into the next system or product.

 - Partner directly with researchers, domain experts, and—where relevant—legal and compliance teams to ensure data is both high-utility and responsibly handled.

 - Identify repeatable patterns across engagements and productize them into reusable software and platforms.

 - Raise the technical bar through strong design judgment, clear communication, code quality, and mentorship.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 2–10 years of recent, demonstrated experience in one or more of: synthetic/LLM-generated data, post-training and model-evaluation work, privacy engineering, or data anonymization/de-identification at scale.

 - A hands-on individual contributor track record—this is not a team-lead or engineering-management role.

 - Strong Python skills and the ability to write clean, efficient, scalable software for large, messy, real-world datasets.

 - Sound judgment for reasoning about data quality, risk, and utility—forming hypotheses, choosing meaningful metrics, diagnosing failures, and distinguishing signal from noise.

 - Experience designing systems—not only implementing specifications—including tradeoffs around quality, scale, reliability, and reuse.

 - Comfort operating in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment with substantial ownership.

 - Collaborative, low-ego communication and the ability to work effectively with researchers, engineers, domain experts, and customers.


ESPECIALLY COMPELLING EXPERIENCE

 - Building or operating large-scale synthetic or LLM-generated data pipelines for model training.

 - Building or operating large-scale data de-identification or anonymization systems, ideally involving relational or graph-structured data, with experience preserving referential/relationship integrity after anonymization.

 - Developing LLM/agent benchmarks, evaluation methodologies, annotation systems, or data-quality frameworks.

 - Research or applied work on reinforcement learning, alignment, model behavior, synthetic data, or human-in-the-loop systems.

 - Prior work in a regulated or high-sensitivity data environment (healthcare, finance, HR/people data, government), or experience with re-identification risk assessment and privacy auditing.

 - Published research, meaningful open-source contributions, or evidence of technical leadership in ML systems, data engineering, or AI research.

 - Experience productizing research or repeated customer work into robust, reusable platforms.


WHY JOIN

 - Work on problems at the center of how frontier AI systems improve, alongside leading labs and domain experts.

 - Help build an early technical organization where your work shapes the roadmap, standards, and culture.

 - Move fluidly from research insight to real-world systems, with the resources and customer context to see those systems matter.

 - Join a company building durable infrastructure for careers in the AI economy.

Shared across the team

 - Support our external penetration testing program, from scoping through retest.

 - Partner with teammates on build pipeline and supply-chain security, especially dependency risk in application code.

 - Design for idempotency, retries, ordering, and reconciliation so financial data stays correct when a step fails

AI connectivity

 - Build and maintain MCP servers that expose governed read and write operations over the revenue chain to internal AI agents

 - Define tool contracts, permission scopes, and guardrails so agents act only within approved boundaries, with every action logged

 - Evaluate Workato's AI and MCP capabilities and adopt them where they fit

 - Meet SOX, SOC 1, and SOC 2 change-management and audit requirements for integrations that touch financial and customer data

 - Share design ownership and on-call coverage across the team so no critical integration depends on one person

We deliver innovative advertising solutions that integrate seamlessly with today’s evolving digital media landscape, powering targeted advertising, measurement, and data-driven decision-making across our global CTV ecosystem.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our engineering team in Bangalore, India. In this role, you will drive the architecture, design, and development of large-scale ad serving, measurement, targeting, and data engineering systems that power LG Ad Solutions’ global advertising platform.

As a senior technical leader, you will own critical technical initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams, establish architectural direction, and drive the delivery of highly scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient distributed systems. You will work closely with engineering, product, and operations teams across geographies, providing technical leadership and collaborating with teams in the US and India to deliver high-impact solutions.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role for an engineer who combines deep software engineering expertise with strong architectural judgment, a track record of solving complex engineering problems, and the ability to influence technical decisions across teams. You will also mentor senior engineers, establish engineering best practices, and help shape the long-term technical roadmap of LG Ad Solutions.

Responsibilities

 - Technical Leadership and Architecture: Define and drive the architecture of large-scale, distributed software systems, making critical technical decisions around scalability, reliability, performance, and maintainability.

 - System Design and Scalability: Design and evolve high-throughput ad serving, targeting, measurement, and data processing systems capable of handling large data volumes and demanding latency requirements.

 - End-to-End Technical Ownership: Lead complex, cross-team engineering initiatives from problem definition and requirements gathering through architecture, implementation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

 - Distributed Systems and Data Engineering: Drive the design and optimization of big data applications and distributed computing platforms, improving processing efficiency, resource utilization, and infrastructure cost.

 - Technical Strategy and Roadmap: Partner with engineering leadership and product teams to define technical strategy, identify architectural gaps, establish long-term roadmaps, and align engineering investments with business priorities.

 - Engineering Excellence: Establish and champion best practices for software design, code quality, testing, observability, operational readiness, and production reliability.

 - Cross-Team Influence: Collaborate across engineering teams and organizational boundaries to resolve complex technical challenges, align architectural decisions, and drive consistent engineering standards.

 - Mentorship and Technical Development: Mentor senior and junior engineers, guide design and code reviews, and help develop technical leadership within the organization.

 - Performance and Reliability: Identify and resolve system bottlenecks, improve service-level objectives, and lead initiatives that enhance throughput, latency, fault tolerance, and overall system resilience.

 - Platform Integrations: Lead the design and implementation of integrations with internal and external platforms to expand advertising targeting, measurement, and data capabilities.

 - Global Collaboration: Work closely with engineering teams in the US and India to drive successful project execution, share technical knowledge, and ensure alignment across distributed teams.

Requirements

 - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - 10+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating large-scale, production-grade software systems.

 - Demonstrated experience leading the architecture and delivery of complex, distributed systems with significant scale, throughput, reliability, or data processing requirements.

 - Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages, such as Go, Scala, Python, Java, or C++, along with a deep understanding of computer science fundamentals.

 - Extensive experience with distributed systems, concurrency, data structures, algorithms, system design, and performance optimization.

 - Hands-on experience with big data technologies such as Apache Spark and Databricks, and data storage and caching technologies such as MySQL, Redis, or ElastiCache.

 - Experience designing, deploying, and operating cloud-native systems using AWS, Kubernetes, and related infrastructure technologies.

 - Ability to navigate, understand, and refactor large, complex codebases while maintaining high standards of reliability and maintainability.

 - Strong understanding of system observability, production troubleshooting, fault tolerance, capacity planning, and cost optimization.

 - Proven ability to make sound architectural trade-offs, evaluate alternative approaches, and influence technical decisions across multiple teams.

 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.

 - Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, guide technical discussions, and raise engineering standards across teams.

 - Experience collaborating with globally distributed engineering teams and driving projects across geographical boundaries.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience building and scaling ad tech platforms, including ad serving, audience targeting, advertising measurement, or real-time bidding systems.

 - Proven track record of leading multi-team technical initiatives and delivering significant business and engineering outcomes.

 - Experience designing high-throughput, low-latency services and large-scale data processing pipelines.

 - Experience with cloud cost optimization, distributed resource management, and large-scale infrastructure efficiency.

 - Experience defining architecture standards, technical roadmaps, and engineering practices across teams.

 - Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority and drive alignment across engineering, product, and operations.

 - Experience mentoring senior engineers and developing technical leaders.

 - Experience working in a global engineering organization with teams across India and the US.

Equal Employment Opportunity

THE PRODUCTION TEAM AT LILT

LILT’s Production Team is a global workforce, operating across four continents.  We are passionate about localization and making information accessible to all.  The Team spans project management, program management, quality, and talent management, working with some of the world’s largest organizations.  

Working in LILT’s Production Team you will have access to leading tools, collaborative teammates, and opportunities to make a real impact.




WHERE YOU’LL WORK

This is a contract position based out of India or Romania

Authorization to work in India or Romania is a precondition of employment.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Formatting and Layout: Apply design and formatting to translated content across various languages, ensuring consistency with the source document and client specifications.

 - File Preparation: Prepare files for translation by extracting and formatting content in required formats, including InDesign, Illustrator, Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and others.

 - Localization: Adapt and localize visual elements such as images, graphs, charts, and documents to fit target languages and regional requirements.

 - Software Utilization: Use DTP tools such as Adobe InDesign, Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, FrameMaker, QuarkXPress, or other desktop publishing software to produce high-quality localized documents.

 - Quality Assurance: Conduct detailed QA checks to ensure the final output is free of errors, adheres to client guidelines, and meets industry standards.

 - Troubleshooting: Resolve issues related to fonts, layout, image compatibility, and other design aspects that may arise due to language changes or technical constraints.

 - Collaboration: Work closely with translators, project managers, and engineers to ensure seamless integration of content into the final design.

 - Version Control: Maintain organized records of multiple versions of the same document to ensure accuracy in project delivery.

 - File Conversion: Convert between different file formats as required by the project, maintaining fidelity to the original layout.

 - Communication: Provide clear communication regarding design adjustments, limitations, and timelines with internal teams and clients.




KEY SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Experience: 2+ years of experience in desktop publishing, preferably in an LSP or localization environment.

 - Technical Proficiency: Strong expertise in DTP tools such as Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, QuarkXPress, Microsoft Office, and other relevant software.

 - Attention to Detail: Keen eye for visual design and layout consistency, ensuring high-quality, error-free output.

 - Language Skills: Experience working with multilingual content and an understanding of language-specific DTP challenges (e.g., character spacing, right-to-left text, non-Latin scripts).

 - File Management: Proficiency in handling and organizing multiple file types, formats, and large datasets.

 - Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work in a team-oriented environment.

 - Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to troubleshoot issues related to formatting and design.

 - Time Management: Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously, meet tight deadlines, and work in a fast-paced environment.

 - Education: Degree or certification in Graphic Design, Desktop Publishing, or a related field is preferred.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Localization Knowledge: Familiarity with translation memory tools such as SDL Trados Studio, memoQ, or Wordfast.

 - International Experience: Previous experience working on projects with multilingual and multicultural elements.

 - Multilingual Skills: Fluency in additional languages is a plus, though not required.

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for professional or semi-professional voice talents with a passion for language and technology for an exciting project. The recordings will be used for model training.




WHAT YOU’LL DELIVER 

 - Voice Samples

 - Voice qualities of interest:
   
   - Bright
   
   - Sultry
   
   - ASMR / soft intimate delivery

 - Expressive delivery (not monotone), conversational style

 - Voice persona: friendly, empathetic, attentive and helpful

 - Voice profile:
   
   - Flawless diction and articulation.
   
   - Consistent quality
   
   - Stable rhythm and tempo
   
   - Controlled pitch and amplitude
   
   - Correct diction and articulation




QUALIFICATIONS 

 - Must be native speaker of (bilingual): HINDI and ENGLISH INDIA

 - Experience with voice acting, narration, podcasting, or streaming

 - Access to a professional or high-quality home recording setup
   
   - Recording software
   
   - Microphone
   
   - Headset/speakers
   
   - Audio Interface
   
   - Professional Digital Audio Workstation, software, plugins
   
   - Treated space, quiet environment, free from background noise, music, clicks, muffling, etc.

 - Able to follow specific technical requirements when recording (volume level, file naming, format, gaps between segments, audio quality, etc.)

 - Able to provide demo, sample recordings, voiceover samples

 - Comfortable with fast-turnaround projects and able to meet tight delivery deadlines when engaged

 - Open to licensing your voice for AI voice cloning / TTS training

 - Depending on the project, you may undergo a test in our module to be subsequently vetted against all requirements.




WHY COLLABORATE WITH LILT?

 - Your schedule, your rules. As an independent contractor, work when you want, as much or as little as you want. No fixed hours, no check-ins, no micromanaging.

 - Work on projects that actually matter. Contribute to cutting-edge AI and language technology that is shaping how humans and machines communicate.

As a 1099 contractor, you won't receive benefits such as health insurance, paid time off, or retirement contributions, and hours are not guaranteed.

Step 2: Submit samples of voice work and/or take a test in our text platform. If a test is required, you will be asked to verify equipment, rates and fees, availability, etc.

Step 3: Once you are selected for a project, we will finalize your onboarding by having you complete our application form and adding you to our community, setting up your account for payments, and completing the remaining onboarding steps.
